lines: You remember. The Anchor Stone ensures it.
The corruption has reset. The towns have forgotten. But you have not.
Your heroes carry scars from a timeline that no longer exists. Interesting.
The Sovereign will try again. He always tries again.
But this time, you know the road. Use that knowledge well.
Shopkeeper! The King sends his regards and... wait.
Have we met before? You look at me like you know what I'm going to say.
...Nevermind. The frontier needs supplies. Same as always, I suppose.
